notes.title: "CAFE 0 ~The Sleeping Beast~ REMASTERED" is now available to wishlist!
notes.content:
The remastered version of "CAFE 0 ~The Sleeping Beast~" is finally having its own Steam store page! Don't forget to wishlist the game :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2197750/CAFE_0_The_Sleeping_Beast_REMASTERED/

[h1]NEW FEATURES ON REMASTERED VERSION[/h1]
[list]
[*] Major graphics update! All backgrounds are redrawn, and all CGs are remastered.
[*] Sprites are also remastered with some color adjustment.
[*] Interfaces are renewed, make it easier to access.
[*] Day Selection feature is added to start the game from the chapter you want.
[*] Controller is now supported.
[*] Full HD resolution.
[*] Lip movements and blinking eyes are now added to the characters.
[/list]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018656/8fbae2b117307c4fad53956fa744dbacbf463452.png[/img]

https://youtu.be/xsGmiZ5Muis

notes.title: Fixed saving issue
notes.content:
I have found that if user started the game by:
Launch the game > choose extras> past memories>back>back>start
the save menu will be disabled.

I have fixed this so please make sure your game has been updated to the newest version.

notes.title: Steam key for the previous purchasers
notes.content:

You can activate the key now, but you won't be able to play until the game is released.
Please email to support@roseverte.net, tell me your purchase email address and the game title, and don't forget to write down "need the steam key" in subject or inside the message.
Or, you can simply reply to the download link email you received, with the message "need the steam key"

I will send the key to you as soon as posisble :)

Regards,
Chu-3
